ops.title: project: 10.4.0 (2026-07-19) doc carve-out bounded (head 6/400 + merged tail 3/200) + DOC_PREFIXES/GO_DOC_SIBLINGS deleted — doc-ness now native-marker OR adjacency via seed-verified generated tables
ops.body:
capt-hook 10.4.0 (2026-07-19, c5b8e0b1 + f5ebe991; general pack 0.28.0) closed the godoc escape from the fusekit/daemonkit report: doc comments keep only their opening paragraph carved out (>6 lines/400 chars denies; merged trailing paragraphs use plain >3/200; separator rows = no-alnum rows, metering chars into the active segment but no lines). `DOC_PREFIXES` and `GO_DOC_SIBLINGS` are DELETED from ast_grep.py (external-pack API removal, flagged in CHANGELOG): `is_doc_run` = native marker kinds (`DOC_COMMENT_KINDS`: rust outer/inner_doc_comment_marker, dart documentation_block_comment) OR declaration adjacency (`DOC_SIBLINGS[lang]`, total dict), both generated into langs.py by hatch_build.py seed-and-verify.

Non-obvious, hard-won:
- ast-grep-py 0.44 has NO kind-enumeration API — `SgRoot("",lang).root().find(kind=X)` RuntimeError membership testing is the only probe; never seed supertype names (js `declaration` probes valid but `.kind()` never returns it). Ruby's decl kind is `method`, hcl's is `block`, elixir's is `call` — English-substring guessing under-covers.
- Seed misses fail CLOSED (non-doc → 3/200); false exemption is the error class to avoid, so `lexical_declaration` stayed OUT and `export_statement` IN.
- User directives, second and third rejection rounds: literals inline (6/400 once in `too_long`), no regex (isalnum), no hard-coded per-lang tables (deleted DOC_PREFIXES unless truly underivable — the seed lists in hatch_build.py are the accepted residue, like [[constants-inline-by-default]]).
- Refuter-accepted envelope: 6-head + separator + 3-tail (9 narration lines) passes BY DESIGN; go in-body `var_spec`/`const_spec` godoc adjacency is pre-existing; duplicate-key legacy exemption is now per-occurrence (Counter).
- Consumer verify recipe: bare cwd → no-hooks ALLOW (false negative); a real check needs `.claude/capt-hook.toml` with `[packs.general]` in the cwd, then `uvx --isolated --from capt-hook==X capt-hook run PreToolUse`.
- Release: v10.3.0 was claimed (untagged) by the concurrent helper-release session → I renumbered to 10.4.0 mid-flight (cc-note 323b63d2 warns them of the plugin.json regress if they still tag v10.3.0; their `helper / release` job is red on tap-trust — not ours). The `ty` prek hook can fail one-shot with "files were modified"; the retry passes.
